name: UNSW Community Plus Scholarship
summary: Accommodation scholarship paying residential college fees for commencing low-SES UNSW students living on campus.
key: Up to $25,000 per annum towards residential fees for minimum program duration.
who: Commencing undergraduate from a low socioeconomic background
how: Complete the separate Accommodation Scholarship Application Form; an approved UNSW Accommodation place is required
catches: Paid directly to the college as accommodation fees
2027 rounds: EAS via UAC by 19 Nov 2026, ES by 10 Dec 2026, with later January and February rounds; offers made through to March 2027
Competitive; meeting the criteria does not guarantee an award

source.label: UNSW Scholarships: UNSW Equity Scholarships for 2027

evidence.claim: Up to $25,000 a year towards residential fees
evidence.quote: Up to $25,000 per annum towards residential fees for minimum program duration
